title_en: Interim Provisions on the Levy of Educational Surcharge

articles.content_en: These Provisions are formulated for the purpose of implementing the Decision of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China on the Reform of the Educational System, accelerating the development of local educational undertakings, and expanding the sources of funding for local educational expenses.

All units and individuals that pay consumption tax, value-added tax, or business tax shall pay educational surcharges in accordance with these Provisions, except for units that pay rural educational undertaking surcharges in accordance with the provisions of the Notice of the State Council on Raising Funds for Running Rural Schools (Document No. 174 [1984] of the State Council).

The educational surcharge shall be levied on the basis of the amount of value-added tax, business tax, and consumption tax actually paid by each unit and individual. The rate of the educational surcharge shall be 3%, and it shall be paid simultaneously with the value-added tax, business tax, and consumption tax respectively.
Unless otherwise provided by the State Council, no region or department shall arbitrarily raise or lower the rate of the educational surcharge.

In accordance with the relevant existing provisions, except for the educational surcharge of the railway system, the head office of the People's Bank of China, the head offices of specialized banks, and the head office of the insurance company, which shall be turned over to the central finance together with the business tax, the educational surcharge of other units and individuals shall be turned over to the local finance on the spot.

The educational surcharge shall be collected by the tax authorities.
The educational surcharge shall be incorporated into budgetary management and used as a special educational fund, and shall be used and managed in accordance with the principle of "collection before expenditure, listing both revenue and expenditure, and balancing revenue and expenditure." Local people's governments at all levels shall, in accordance with the relevant provisions of the State, gradually increase the budgetary educational undertaking funds, and shall not offset the appropriations for educational undertakings because the educational surcharge is incorporated into the management of special budgetary funds.
The collection and management of the educational surcharge shall be handled in accordance with the relevant provisions on consumption tax, value-added tax, and business tax.
The educational surcharge paid by enterprises shall be paid entirely from sales revenue (or operating revenue).

The educational surcharge collected by local governments shall be managed as a special fund. It shall be planned and arranged in a coordinated manner by the education department, which shall propose a distribution plan, and after consultation with the finance department at the same level and obtaining its consent, shall be used to improve teaching facilities and school conditions in primary and secondary schools, and shall not be used for employee welfare or the distribution of bonuses.
The educational surcharge turned over together with the business tax by the railway system, the head office of the People's Bank of China, the head offices of specialized banks, and the head office of the insurance company shall be used for the weak links of basic education, with the State Education Commission proposing a distribution plan on an annual basis, after consultation with the Ministry of Finance and obtaining its consent.
The educational surcharge collected by local governments shall mainly be retained by the local authorities for their use. The people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government may, in accordance with the actual circumstances of the collection of educational surcharges in various localities, appropriately withdraw a portion of the amount for adjustment and balancing among regions.

Local education departments at all levels shall report regularly each year to the local people's government, the competent department at a higher level, and the finance department on the revenue and expenditure of the educational surcharge.

Any unit that runs a school for the children of its employees shall first pay the educational surcharge in accordance with these Provisions; the education department may, in light of the circumstances of the school running, refund the amount to the unit running the school as a subsidy for the school's funds. The unit running the school shall not use the payment of the educational surcharge as a pretext to close or merge the school, or to reduce the scale of the school.

Article 11 After the collection of the educational surcharge, local education departments and schools at all levels shall not raise funds from students' parents or units under any pretext, nor engage in disguised fund-raising, and shall not refuse admission to students under any excuse.
For those who violate the provisions of the preceding paragraph, their higher-level education departments shall stop them, and the directly responsible persons shall be given administrative sanctions. Units and individuals shall have the right to refuse payment.

Article 12 The Ministry of Finance shall be responsible for the interpretation of these Provisions. The people's governments of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government may formulate implementing measures in light of local actual conditions.
Article 13 These Provisions shall come into force as of July 1, 1986.
